page_title: ACM 0-0 JUV | AC Milan v Juventus 23/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Daniele Chiffi has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' A brilliant cross into the box finds Theo Hernandez (AC Milan), who steers his low header towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
90+3' Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
90+1' Thiago Motta has decided to substitute Nicolo Savona and he is replaced by Danilo (Juventus).
90+1' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90+1' That will be all from Kenan Yildiz who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Samuel Mbangula (Juventus).
88' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
87' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) sees a yellow card from Daniele Chiffi after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
86' Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
84' Substitution. Strahinja Pavlovic (AC Milan) on for Matteo Gabbia.
84' Here is a change. Emerson Royal is going off and Paulo Fonseca gives the last tactical orders to Davide Calabria (AC Milan).
84' Substitution. Samuel Chukwueze (AC Milan) in, Yunus Musah out.
83' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Juventus in a dangerous position.
83' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
81' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) wastes a big chance! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box and it goes narrowly over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
80' Thiago Motta decides to make a substitution. Weston McKennie will be replaced by Nicolo Fagioli (Juventus).
80' Today's match ends for Francisco Conceicao who will be replaced by Timothy Weah (Juventus).
79' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul. Juventus are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

78' The game is interrupted. Emerson Royal (AC Milan) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. It's a free kick to Juventus, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
78' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
77' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for AC Milan.
74' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
74' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Juventus, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
72' An opponent rises to his feet after being downed by Yunus Musah (AC Milan). Daniele Chiffi saw the sliding tackle and blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Juventus.
70' Here comes a substitution. Ruben Loftus-Cheek is given a rest as he is replaced by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
69' Youssouf Fofana (AC Milan) argues with the referee and is booked for dissent.
69' One of the AC Milan players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
68' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) dinks a fine lofted pass from the free kick. However, one of the defenders heads the ball out of danger.
67' Daniele Chiffi shows the yellow card to Emerson Royal (AC Milan) for a heavy challenge.
64' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) lashes the free kick from the edge of the box but it flies high over the bar, somewhere into the stands. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
63' Pierre Kalulu (Juventus) commits a rough challenge and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for an infringement. AC Milan get a free kick.
63' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the right side of the goal, but Mike Maignan is equal to it and makes an easy save.
61' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
60' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

60' Juventus failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat. Juventus have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
59' The corner is swung in but Juventus can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Juventus.
59' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.
58' The Juventus players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
56' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger.
55' Weston McKennie (Juventus) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. AC Milan earn a free kick.
53' Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alvaro Morata (AC Milan). That's a free kick to Juventus.
51' The corner from Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is intercepted by Mike Maignan.
50' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. Corner kick. Juventus will have an opportunity.
49' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
49' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Rafael Leao (AC Milan).
47' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) delivers a poor cross from a free kick as one of the defenders comfortably clears it away.
47' Weston McKennie (Juventus) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. AC Milan will take a free kick.
46' Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.

45+2' Emerson Royal (AC Milan) is furious with himself for wasting a glorious chance. He got to a rebound inside the 6-yard box, but his header flew narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Juventus.
45+2' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Theo Hernandez (AC Milan). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
45+1' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Emerson Royal (AC Milan). AC Milan force a corner. They send men into the box.
44' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul. Juventus are awarded the free kick.
43' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Yunus Musah (AC Milan) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
38' Alvaro Morata (AC Milan) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
38' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
37' Daniele Chiffi blows for a foul after Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. AC Milan have a free kick.
36' A crossfield pass from Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) fails to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Juventus will have a goal kick.
34' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.

32' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Daniele Chiffi stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. AC Milan win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
31' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
29' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle. AC Milan win a free kick.
27' Federico Gatti (Juventus) fouls his opponent and receives a yellow card from the referee, but he is clearly not happy with the decision.
26' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) sees a yellow! His tackle wasn't that harsh, but he probably talked himself into Daniele Chiffi's book.
25' Dangerous play by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus). Daniele Chiffi blows his whistle for a foul. AC Milan will take a free kick near the side line.
24' AC Milan are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.

23' Golden chance! Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
19' A pass from Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) is intercepted by Mike Maignan and the move breaks down.
18' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Michele Di Gregorio, who smothers the ball.
16' Federico Gatti (Juventus) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Mike Maignan is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
11' Daniele Chiffi has a clear sight and sees a foul from Kenan Yildiz (Juventus). Free kick. AC Milan will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

10' Golden opportunity! Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) lost his marker inside the box, only to shoot just wide of the left post after receiving a good pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AC Milan.
8' A decent cross into the box is met first time by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus), but his powerful goalbound effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
6' Referee Daniele Chiffi sees the trip by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to AC Milan.
5' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! A free kick has been awarded to AC Milan.

4' Federico Gatti (Juventus) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniele Chiffi with no other option than to blow for a foul. AC Milan are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
3' AC Milan keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
1' The first half has started.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Juventus will have the kick-off.
Daniele Chiffi was nominated as the referee for this game.
